lessons: Premise false: the ticket says served_review and lifted_report_paths can drop their e.ticket == stem filter, but tests/integration/test_merge.py:531 wrong-stem-inline and wrong-stem-queue require rejecting a completion whose key names the stem but whose ticket names another stem.

Both wrong-stem cases pass on the base commit and fail on the candidate, run in isolation. A completion written by stages.lift_outbox with ticket=stem does not make the filter redundant, because the custody tests journal a forged completion directly.

Revise the Scope in so lifted_report_paths and served_review keep checking completion ownership, e.g. filter Effects.recorded results by ticket or add a ticket argument. Then add tests/integration/test_merge.py to Scope fence and Verification, or keep its assertions unchanged.

Rework criterion 3 and the drop-filter rationale in Scope in. test_lift_outbox_ticket.py pins only the honest writer, not custody against forged completions. Leave checkpoint._history inline; the attempt confirmed it validates a whole history of keys.
